_about: THE SHRINKING PENDING LIST for `money-face.spec.ts` (D221, confirmed 2026-09-23: mono everywhere, inputs and chips included, plus a check). KEY SHAPE: route -> amount -> the lane that owes the fix. The amount is the figure exactly as the screen draws it ('$4.20', '$50') or a money field's value. An entry excuses that ONE figure: a new figure drawn in the wrong face on the same route is still red. The fixture is deterministic (`routeSweep.ts`), so a route draws the same figures every run. `money-face.spec.ts` fails on an unlisted hit AND on a listed entry with no hit this run (stale — delete it). A lane migrating a screen's money onto `.bn-money`/`Money` deletes its own entries in the same commit. Measured at 1440 and 390, 2026-09-24: `#/shipping` draws its per-order values and the under-$50 rule in Inter.
